source: Dung (1995); research/ARCHITECTURE.md Question 2 (undec propagates to anything reachable only through the cycle)
description: a claim whose only supporting argument is itself caught in an unrelated two-node cycle, where the claim's own id is not a node in the attack graph at all
reasoning: this exercises the other cycle-detection path from the self-attacking and mutual-attack fixtures: the claim is never directly attacked, so its own label is never consulted — it is open with reason cycle because its sole supporting argument never resolves out of undec, not because the claim itself is part of the cycle
